wins.label: Exceptional Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Q4 overall revenue surged 70% year-over-year, our highest growth rate as a public company

wins.label: Record Profitability with Growth
wins.evidence: Rule of 40 score reached new heights at 127%, proving that hyper growth and exceptional profitability aren't mutually exclusive

wins.label: U.S. Commercial Acceleration
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial business grew 137% year-over-year and 28% sequentially, defying conventional enterprise software dynamics

wins.label: Record TCV Bookings
wins.evidence: Closed our highest TCV quarter ever at $4.3 billion, up 138% year-over-year

wins.label: Customer Expansion at Scale
wins.evidence: Fourth quarter trailing 12-month revenue from our top 20 customers increased 45% year-over-year to $94 million per customer

risks.label: International Commercial Weakness
risks.evidence: Fourth quarter international commercial revenue grew 8% year-over-year and 2% for full year, significantly lagging U.S. performance

risks.label: Execution Risk on Guidance
risks.evidence: Guiding to 61% growth for 2026, a significant deceleration from 70% in Q4, execution risk on maintaining momentum

risks.label: Geopolitical and Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Heavy reliance on U.S. government business (77% of revenue) creates exposure to policy changes and budget constraints

risks.label: Expense Growth Acceleration
risks.evidence: Q4 adjusted expense was up 34% year-over-year; company expects expenses to continue increasing in 2026

risks.label: Strategic Commercial Contract Decline
risks.evidence: Anticipate 2026 revenue from strategic commercial contracts to be less than $7 million or less than 0.1% of full year revenue, down from prior levels
